claim: All hematopoietic stem cells segregate their chromosomes randomly.
label: SUPPORTED

evidence.text: In each case, less than 6% of HSCs retained BrdU and less than 0.5% of all BrdU-retaining haematopoietic cells were HSCs, revealing that BrdU has poor specificity and poor sensitivity as an HSC marker.
evidence.title: Haematopoietic stem cells do not asymmetrically segregate chromosomes or retain BrdU
